notes: eng_for_zho is clean and dominated by false positives (~80%): English target morphology drives 63 inflection FPs (speak/speaks/speaking, word/words, want/wanted, think/thought, do/did) and 75 subgloss FPs where high-frequency Chinese function/content words (说,想,会,不,我,你,是) are sliced as 'component' inside larger LEGOs or whole-sentence legos, never drilled bare. Only one true release-blocker: 好 is drilled as Well/Yes/Good/Great (genuinely distinct intentions). Most real_differentiate items are USE/BUILD sentence rows that share a normalized known stem but carry mismatched English (verb/negation/adjunct swaps from seeds 66-73) — likely known-text truncation in flag extraction, worth a decomposition check rather than deep harm; and a recurring like/enjoy and quantifier (more/many) glossing choice runs course-wide.
